description.value: Forested Recreation Site on the sheltered east shore of Harrison Lake, a draw for swimmers and kayakers; no potable water, pack-out garbage, pit toilets only, cash fees, and a forest-service-road approach.

address.value: 15km, Harrison East Forest Service Rd, Harrison Hot Springs, BC V0M 1A0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content provides comprehensive primary evidence for this rustic Recreation Site. Key facts confirmed by the website: no potable water, no electricity, no showers, pit toilets only, no cell service, cash-only payment, and reservations accepted online. OSM tags for shower=no and washing_machine=no align with the website's 'rustic dry camping' characterization. The site is confirmed open for 2026 per the website's seasonal opening announcement.
concerns: No phone number available in OSM or on website — contact is via email only (harrisoneast@hotmail.com).
No street address provided in OSM; site is remote with no cell service, requiring cyclists to plan navigation in advance.
Cash-only site — cyclists must carry sufficient cash as no card payment is accepted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operated Recreation Site on Harrison Lake run in partnership with Recreation Sites & Trails BC, representing a viable overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley region.
enrichment_extras.notes: Site is co-managed by Greenshades Enterprises and Recreation Sites & Trails BC. The same operator runs Bear Creek and Cogburn Beach campgrounds under the harrisoneastcamping.com domain, which may warrant separate OSM review for those sites.
